params.body:
## What

`laravel/framework` goes from v13.38.0 to v13.42.0, with the packages below it. Only `composer.lock` moves; `composer.json` is unchanged (`^13.0`).

## Why

The CI job "Dependencies carry no new advisory" (`composer audit --locked`) fails on `main` and on every open pull request since 2026-11-13:

- CVE-2026-128083 / GHSA-63hm-g96r-2m2q, "Task Output Injection - Concurrency Process", severity low, affects `laravel/framework >=13.0.0,<13.40.0`.

After the update `composer audit --locked` reports no advisories.

## What moved

`composer update laravel/framework --with-dependencies`: 18 packages, none added, none removed. No other root requirement moved.

| Package | From | To |
|---|---|---|
| laravel/framework | v13.38.0 | v13.42.0 |
| doctrine/inflector | 2.1.0 | 2.1.1 |
| guzzlehttp/guzzle | 7.16.0 | 7.16.1 |
| guzzlehttp/psr7 | 2.13.2 | 2.13.3 |
| laravel/prompts | v0.3.26 | v0.3.27 |
| laravel/serializable-closure | v2.1.0 | v2.2.0 |
| league/commonmark | 2.10.4 | 2.10.7 |
| league/uri | 7.9.0 | 7.10.0 |
| nesbot/carbon | 3.15.0 | 3.15.1 |
| nunomaduro/termwind | v2.4.0 | v2.4.1 |
| ramsey/uuid | 4.9.4 | 4.10.0 |
| symfony/polyfill-php85 | v1.43.0 | v1.44.0 |
| vlucas/phpdotenv | v5.7.0 | v5.8.0 |
| doctrine/deprecations | 1.1.6 | 1.2.0 |
| league/uri-interfaces | 7.9.0 | 7.10.0 |
| nette/schema | v1.3.6 | v1.4.0 |
| nette/utils | v4.1.5 | v4.1.6 |
| webmozart/assert | 2.5.0 | 2.5.1 |

The first thirteen are the framework and its direct requirements. The last five sit one level deeper in the same tree and came along with `--with-dependencies`.

## One change in the code

The new framework encodes a bare string passed to `route()` as a query string: `route('location.store.modal', 'redirect=transport')` gave `?redirect=transport` on v13.38.0 and gives `?redirect%3Dtransport` on v13.42.0. The address window opened from the transport tab posts to that address, so after saving the dealer would no longer return to the transport tab.

`resources/views/settings/location/modal.blade.php` now passes `['redirect' => 'transport']`, which gives the same address on both versions. The test that posts to the same address follows. It was the only `route()` call in `app`, `resources` and `routes` that passes a query as a string; the others that pass a string fill a path parameter and are not affected.

## Tested

- `composer audit --locked`: no advisories.
- PHPStan: no errors.
- Full suite on v13.42.0: green, except the six cases of `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest`, which fail locally on a reused test database on v13.38.0 as well and pass on a fresh one.
- `TransportAddressFromTheRequestTest` failed in two cases before the change in the view and passes with it.
params.title: Update laravel/framework to v13.42.0 for CVE-2026-128083
